title: Georgia child well-being update
summary: Georgia dropped to 39th in the national child well-being rankings, highlighting continued challenges for families and youth in education, health, and economic stability.

title: KIDS COUNT Data Book
summary: Georgia Family Connection Partnership released the annual KIDS COUNT Data Book with updated statistics on child health, education, and family economic well-being.

title: Communities In Schools Impact Report
summary: Communities In Schools of Georgia shared stories and outcomes showing how site coordinators connect students with resources to keep them on track to graduate.

title: Food Insecurity Remains a Concern
summary: Golden Harvest Food Bank partners with local Family Connection collaboratives to reduce weekend hunger through backpack and school pantry programs.

title: Federal grants freeze threatens after-school programs
summary: The Trump administration is withholding over $6 billion in federal grants, including funding for critical after-school and summer programs nationwide.

title: Georgia at risk of losing up to $100M in after-school funding
summary: Federal budgeting freezes could eliminate nearly $100 million in funding for after-school and summer programs in Georgia, putting services for low-income students in jeopardy.

title: ‘It’s a crisis’: GA, SC programs in limbo under funding cuts
summary: After-school and summer programs in Georgia and South Carolina face an uncertain future due to withheld federal funding, affecting thousands of students.

title: Georgia’s Child Welfare System
summary: The Georgia Division of Family and Children Services is working to improve child welfare services, focusing on prevention and family support.

title: Statewide Youth Leadership Summit
summary: The annual summit brought together youth leaders from across Georgia to discuss issues affecting their communities and develop leadership skills.

title: New Early Childhood Education Initiatives
summary: Georgia launches new initiatives to expand access to quality early childhood education programs for underserved communities.
